Question B-005-001-003. Lesson link: L-005-01.

Why the correct answer is right: The prefix kilo means 1 000, so 1 kHz is 1 000 Hz.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: This treats kilo as ten.
- sourceIndex 2: This treats kilo as one hundred.
- sourceIndex 3: This treats kilo as ten thousand.
